QuestionStmt.S: Find out number of carbon atoms present in 0.35 mole of glucose.

Solution.S:
Glucose formula: $C_6H_{12}O_6$. Each molecule has 6 carbon atoms.

Number of glucose molecules = $0.35 \times 6.022 \times 10^{23} = 2.1077 \times 10^{23}$.

Number of carbon atoms = $2.1077 \times 10^{23} \times 6 = 1.26462 \times 10^{24}$.

Thus the correct option is C: $1.264 \times 10^{24}$.
